result.note: Defence commissioning with concrete platform facts; one pairs question matching each ship to its role or capability.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, three indigenously designed naval ships were commissioned at Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port in Kolkata. Consider the following pairs:
items: INS Sanshodhak — Hydrographic and oceanographic work
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: The third pair is wrong. BrahMos missiles are carried by INS Dunagiri, the fifth Project 17A stealth frigate, while INS Agray carries lightweight torpedoes and shallow-water sonar. All three ships were built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) to Indian Navy designs, with indigenous content above 75%.
questions.source: INS Dunagiri, the fifth Project 17A stealth frigate, carries BrahMos surface-to-surface missiles and a medium-range surface-to-air missile system.
